title: Stack Exposure Checker
one_liner: Paste your PHP version and composer.lock to see end-of-life status and known vulnerabilities.
headline: Paste a PHP version and composer.lock, get a live, prioritized vulnerability report with a client-ready summary you can copy into an email.

episode.title: SpaceX’s AI Business Up 830%, OpenAI Agents Lie, and Startup Turns Mercury Into Gold | EP #305

history.summary: A genuinely working tool: it queries endoflife.date and OSV.dev live from the browser, correctly maps OSV's affected-range data to the installed version (verified the fixed-version extraction logic against the bundled example data by hand), and only shows canned output when explicitly in "cached example" mode with a one-click live refresh. Figures are attributed correctly and the UI/README never present simulated data as real. Minor polish gaps (an unused CSS class, a slightly ambiguous empty-state message) keep it from a 9, but this is close to publish-ready.
